name: Data.TameChar.IsIntegralMeasure.norm_sq
summary: |F|² = F·F̄ is the integral measure on the pairs (α, β) with points u_α·u_β⁻¹ and coefficients c_α·c̄_β.

steps.claim: Given F(ϑ′) = ∑ c_α ϑ′(u_α), take the points u_α·u_β⁻¹ and the coefficients c_α·conj(c_β) over pairs (α, β): they are integral away from Q (products of such numbers, conjugation preserving integrality at l), and |F(ϑ′)|² = F(ϑ′)·conj F(ϑ′) = ∑_{α,β} c_α conj(c_β) ϑ′(u_α u_β⁻¹), because ϑ′ takes values on the unit circle (conj ϑ′(u) = ϑ′(u)⁻¹).
steps.lean:
ϑ.IsIntegralMeasure (‖F ·‖ ^ 2) := fun ⟨α, _, u, c, a, b⟩ ↦ ⟨_,
  inferInstance, fun (x, y) ↦ u x * (u y)⁻¹, _, fun x ↦ mul_mem (a x.1) fun l ↦ (a x.2 l · <| ·.comp
  _), fun _ e ↦ by simp [*, ← mul_conj', univ.sum_mul_sum, sum_prod_type, ↓coe_inv_eq_conj]; ac_rfl⟩
